name: Identity
tagline: Pass-through ablation: no normalization applied to the TD-MPC2 latent representations.
diff_from_baseline: Ablation: removes the latent normalization to quantify how much SimNorm contributes versus an unnormalized world-model latent.

name: L2 Normalization
tagline: Project the entire latent vector onto the unit hypersphere with a single learnable scale.
diff_from_baseline: Hypersphere normalization preserving angular relationships between latent vectors. Common alternative to simplex/RMS schemes; used in metric-learning style representations.

name: Group RMSNorm
tagline: Group-wise root-mean-square normalization with learnable per-element gain (Zhang & Sennrich 2019).
diff_from_baseline: Zhang & Sennrich 2019 (NeurIPS) — "Root Mean Square Layer Normalization". Same group structure as SimNorm but RMS-normalize each group instead of softmax (no simplex constraint).

name: SimNorm
tagline: Simplicial normalization (TD-MPC2 default): reshape latent into groups and apply softmax within each group.
diff_from_baseline: Hansen, Su, Wang 2024 (ICLR) — TD-MPC2. Default simplicial normalization that constrains latent groups to a product of probability simplices, providing implicit categorical structure for the world-model latent.
